# Acceptance tests, Board, run

Tests for the Board, run steps, in build order. Form and pass rule: [Acceptance tests](acceptance.md).

## Run

- **RUN-01**: Setup: order 3 Diplomatic pouch open, board not locked, a wiring that reaches INSPECTOR. Do: flip the run switch; read the board and the run time before the first beat; close the report; flip it again and read the check counts before the first beat. Expect: [RUN-01](../board/run.md#run-01-start).
- **RUN-02**: Setup: order 13 Embassy dinner open; wires IN → SLICER; SLICER item → LAMINATOR; SLICER copy → LAMINATOR; LAMINATOR → Embassy. Do: run; read each beat's moves in order, and the run time after each beat. Then open order 14 Moon Base birthday with IN → SLICER 1; SLICER 1 item → SLICER 2; SLICER 1 copy → SLICER 1, run, and read the copies' numbers. Expect: [RUN-02](../board/run.md#run-02-beat).
- **RUN-03**: Setup: order 1 Signing ceremony open; wires IN → LAMINATOR; LAMINATOR → World Council. Do: run; read each item after it reaches World Council. Expect: [RUN-03](../board/run.md#run-03-arrive).
- **RUN-04**: Setup: order 2 Victory parade open; wire IN → LAMINATOR only. Do: run; close the report; cut that wire; run again. Expect: [RUN-04](../board/run.md#run-04-stop).
- **RUN-05**: Setup: order 13 Embassy dinner open, PassLimit as the order sets it; wires IN → SLICER; SLICER item → Embassy; SLICER copy → INSPECTOR; INSPECTOR minus → INSPECTOR; INSPECTOR plus → TASTER; TASTER minus → TASTER. Do: run; read where each copy ends. Expect: [RUN-05](../board/run.md#run-05-reject).
- **RUN-06**: Setup: order 1 Signing ceremony open, RunLimit; wires IN → LAMINATOR; LAMINATOR → LAMINATOR. Do: run; close the report; move the end of LAMINATOR's wire to World Council; run again. Expect: [RUN-06](../board/run.md#run-06-end). **Derived:** the first run's run time is RunLimit.
- **RUN-07**: Setup: order 8 Treaty ceremony open; wires IN → TRANSLATOR; TRANSLATOR → LAMINATOR; LAMINATOR → Senate. Do: run; read which items match; then wire IN → LAMINATOR; LAMINATOR → TRANSLATOR; TRANSLATOR → Senate and run again. Expect: [RUN-07](../board/run.md#run-07-match).
- **RUN-08**: Setup: order 13 Embassy dinner open; wires IN → INSPECTOR; INSPECTOR plus → LAMINATOR; INSPECTOR minus → SLICER; SLICER item → Canteen; SLICER copy → LAMINATOR; LAMINATOR → Embassy. Do: run; close the report; cut LAMINATOR → Embassy; run again. Expect: [RUN-08](../board/run.md#run-08-result).

## Par and score

- **PAR-01**: Setup: orders 1 Signing ceremony and 4 Archive day in the Orders data, with their WirePar and TimePar; the wiring search. Do: list the winning wirings; read the fewest wires and the fewest beats among them. Expect: [PAR-01](../board/par-and-score.md#par-01-setting-par). **Derived:** WirePar is the fewest wires among the winning wirings, TimePar the fewest beats among them; no WirePar when every known win uses as many wires, no TimePar when every one takes as many beats.
- **PAR-02**: Setup: order 4 Archive day open, WirePar and TimePar set; wires IN → INSPECTOR; INSPECTOR plus → LAMINATOR 1; LAMINATOR 1 → Archive; INSPECTOR minus → SHREDDER; SHREDDER → LAMINATOR 2; LAMINATOR 2 → Archive. Do: win; read the mission report's score lines; move SHREDDER's wire to LAMINATOR 1, cut LAMINATOR 2's wire, win again; read them. Open order 11 Picnic day, an order with both pars and not split; win with its line in [Test wirings](wirings.md); read them. Expect: [PAR-02](../board/par-and-score.md#par-02-score). **Derived:** the wire count is every wire on the board; wire par is met when it is at or under WirePar; time par is met when the run time is at or under TimePar.
- **PAR-03**: Setup: order 4 Archive day open, WirePar and TimePar set; wiring A: IN → INSPECTOR; INSPECTOR plus → LAMINATOR 1; LAMINATOR 1 → Archive; INSPECTOR minus → SHREDDER; SHREDDER → LAMINATOR 2; LAMINATOR 2 → Archive; wiring B: A with SHREDDER → LAMINATOR 1 and no LAMINATOR 2 wire. Do: win with A, then B, then A again; after each win read the par lamps and the kept bests. Expect: [PAR-03](../board/par-and-score.md#par-03-best). **Derived:** the best wires is the fewest wire count over the wins; the best beats is the fewest run time over the wins.

## Reports

- **REPORT-01**: Setup: order 1 Signing ceremony open on its opening wiring. Do: run; read the lead and the second line; close the report; wire IN → LAMINATOR; LAMINATOR → World Council; run again; read the lead and the lines after it. Expect: [REPORT-01](../board/reports.md#report-01-form-and-lead).
- **REPORT-02**: Setup: ItemLinesMax, ItemBlocksMax; order 13 Embassy dinner open; wires IN → SLICER; SLICER item → INSPECTOR; INSPECTOR minus → INSPECTOR; SLICER copy → Embassy. Do: run; read the report. Then in order 18 Moving day wire IN → COMPACTOR; COMPACTOR → LAMINATOR 1; LAMINATOR 1 → GAUGE; GAUGE plus → LAMINATOR 2; LAMINATOR 2 → RESTORER; GAUGE minus → RESTORER; RESTORER → LAMINATOR 1; run; read the first item's path. Then in order 13 wire IN → SLICER; SLICER item → SLICER; SLICER copy → Embassy; run; read the item blocks. Expect: [REPORT-02](../board/reports.md#report-02-item-lines). **Derived:** item blocks printed before the cut line are ItemBlocksMax less two; path lines printed before a cut line are ItemLinesMax less two.
- **REPORT-03**: Setup: order 2 Victory parade open; wires IN → LAMINATOR; LAMINATOR → SHREDDER; SHREDDER → Parade Control. Do: run; read each item's result line; close the report; wire IN → Parade Control; run again; read them. Expect: [REPORT-03](../board/reports.md#report-03-result-line).
- **REPORT-04**: Setup: PrintLineTime; the smallest screen of the vision's Platform; order 13 Embassy dinner open; wires IN → SLICER; SLICER item → SLICER; SLICER copy → Embassy. Do: run and skip to the report; let it print some lines; tap once; drag on the printout; tap to close; run the same wiring again. Expect: [REPORT-04](../board/reports.md#report-04-print). **Derived:** a report prints in its line count times PrintLineTime.
- **REPORT-05**: Setup: order 13 Embassy dinner open; wires IN → SLICER; SLICER item → LAMINATOR; SLICER copy → LAMINATOR; LAMINATOR → Canteen. Do: run; read each failing item's first difference; close the report; wire IN → SLICER; SLICER item → INSPECTOR; INSPECTOR minus → INSPECTOR; SLICER copy → Embassy; run; read them again. Expect: [REPORT-05](../board/reports.md#report-05-first-difference).
- **REPORT-06**: Setup: order 17 Night scrap run open on its opening wiring. Do: run with no wire changed; read the item lines. Expect: [REPORT-06](../board/reports.md#report-06-repair-orders).

## Run view

- **VIEW-01**: Setup: BeatTime; order 13 Embassy dinner open; wires IN → SLICER; SLICER item → Embassy; SLICER copy → INSPECTOR; INSPECTOR minus → INSPECTOR; INSPECTOR plus → TASTER; TASTER minus → TASTER. Do: run at normal speed; watch the run switch, the items, the lamps and the rejected items. Expect: [VIEW-01](../board/run-view.md#view-01-play). **Derived:** the run's beats play in the run time times BeatTime.
- **VIEW-07**: Setup: order 8 Treaty ceremony open; wires IN → TRANSLATOR; TRANSLATOR → LAMINATOR; LAMINATOR → Senate. Do: run; watch each item reach Senate. Expect: [VIEW-07](../board/run-view.md#view-07-arrival).
- **VIEW-02**: Setup: ViewMargin, ViewMoveTime, ViewHold; the smallest screen of the vision's Platform; order 9 Colony bulletin open at JackMinSize zoom; wires IN → SUMMARIZER; SUMMARIZER → TRANSLATOR; TRANSLATOR → LAMINATOR 2; LAMINATOR 2 → Colonies. Do: run; watch the view from the first item to the last framing. Expect: [VIEW-02](../board/run-view.md#view-02-follow).
- **VIEW-03**: Setup: BeatTime, FastFactor, AutoFastBeat, RunLimit; order 1 Signing ceremony open; wires IN → LAMINATOR; LAMINATOR → LAMINATOR. Do: run; tap fast-forward twice; let the run pass AutoFastBeat beats; tap fast-forward; then tap skip. Expect: [VIEW-03](../board/run-view.md#view-03-fast-and-skip). **Derived:** a beat at fast speed takes BeatTime divided by FastFactor.
- **VIEW-04**: Setup: order 1 Signing ceremony open; wire IN → LAMINATOR only; its hand-written result for that stop not filed. Do: run and let the alarm play; run the same wiring again; cut the wire; run and tap during the alarm. Expect: [VIEW-04](../board/run-view.md#view-04-full-alarm).
- **VIEW-05**: Setup: ViewMoveTime; order 1 Signing ceremony open; wires IN → LAMINATOR; LAMINATOR → World Council. Do: run; tap to close the report; read the board; try to move a wire. Expect: [VIEW-05](../board/run-view.md#view-05-return).
- **VIEW-06**: Setup: RunLimit; order 1 Signing ceremony open; wires IN → LAMINATOR; LAMINATOR → LAMINATOR. Do: run; hide the page mid-run; show it again. Expect: [VIEW-06](../board/run-view.md#view-06-hidden).
